qualification_scope: Three strict isolated restore lifecycles on two physical H100 GPUs, plus a fourth strict lifecycle from the real production renderer. Public rollout remains separate.
limitations: Same runtime image, precision, checkpoint, H100 class, driver and kernel only; other GPU families remain unqualified.
Original r7 and failed verbose-capture directories are not selected or overwritten.
Approximately 37-second container-to-ready measurements retain host/image caches; cross-node image pull cost was separately 164.59 seconds.
First-frame V2V may change physical motion. Transfer is not established as lighting-only or action-safe training augmentation.
Explicit edge/blur preset adapter qualification is separate from the immutable public V4 default adapter.
No public owner cache policy, replica setting or serving route is modified by preparation.
